title: Football Watchability

provenance.note: Built 2026-11-02 from ESPN schedules, lines, records, AP poll, FPI and matchup predictor, plus game-day forecasts. Lines and forecasts move during the week.

broadcastNote: TV/streaming uses ESPN listings for Oct. 27–Nov. 2, 2026, with missing or pending channels checked against FOX and CBS Sports. Final channel selections can remain pending; local NFL availability varies.
footerNotes: Weather: Open-Meteo hourly forecast for each game window (about one reading per quarter), fetched 2026-11-02 02:44 UTC. Impact ratings weigh wind, rain, storms, snow and heat or cold; forecasts sharpen as kickoff nears.

Playoff odds "now" are ESPN FPI. With-a-win / with-a-loss odds are estimates that keep FPI's number as the weighted average using ESPN's win probability. AP and NFL power-rank moves are rule-of-thumb estimates.
Series records are all-time: Winsipedia for college (vacated wins not counted), FiveThirtyEight's NFL game file through 2003 plus ESPN since, playoffs included.

Watchability forecast: 35 base points plus team quality (FPI, 27), competitiveness (win probability, 19), playoff stakes (15), marquee matchup (6), TV window (3) and, for a rivalry, up to 4 more; FCS opponents cost 12. Finished games get an actual score on the same scale from the finish (21), drama (17), late tension (11), stakes and quality (10), surprise (7) and scoring (4), using ESPN win probability and scoring plays.

watch: NFC East game: the Eagles (3rd) and the Commanders (4th) play for tiebreakers as well as the win.
This series lives on the margins: 24–22 in 2026 and 36–33 in 2024.
A long, even rivalry: Commanders lead 91–88–5 over 184 games.
skip: O/U 40.5 for Eagles–Commanders is one of the week's lowest totals — expect a field-position grind.
Both teams have losing records (Eagles 2-5, Commanders 1-4-1).
The Eagles have lost 5 straight coming in (2-5).
